concept.hr: Kružno, najmanje veza, hash i kolačić; provjere ispravnosti
concept.en: Round robin vs least connections vs hash vs sticky; health checks

summary.hr: Devet zahtjeva kroz obrnuti proxy na dva do četiri poslužitelja. Promijeni raspodjelu, uspori ili sruši b2 i gledaj 502, 504 i provjere.
summary.en: Nine requests through a reverse proxy to two to four backends. Change the algorithm, slow or break b2, and watch 502, 504 and the checks.

title.en: Least connections and a slow backend

concept.hr: Spori b2 drži veze otvorene i dobiva 2 od 9 zahtjeva; kružno bi dobio 3
concept.en: The slow b2 keeps connections open and gets 2 of 9 requests; round robin gives 3

concept.hr: b2 otkaže u 4 s, isključen je tek u 8 s; do tada njegovi zahtjevi dobivaju 502
concept.en: b2 fails at 4 s and is marked down only at 8 s; until then its requests get 502
